name: package-manifest-update
body: The release workflow updates the Homebrew formula (`Formula/`) and Scoop manifest (`bucket/`) to the new version, asset URLs and SHA-256 checksums for each target, and pushes them as a manifest-only commit to really-knows-ai/ey-present (the one CI push the humans-push-and-tag constraint allows). AC: after a release, both files reference the new version and their checksums match the published assets; the CI commit touches only files under `Formula/` and `bucket/`; CI creates no tags.
